revenue.source: stockanalysis.com/stocks/csco/financials (Cisco 10-K data; FY2026 ended Jul 25 2026, 10-K accession 0000858877-26-000132; FY2025 10-K 0000858877-25-000111)

d_and_a.source: stockanalysis.com cash-flow-statement page, Depreciation & Amortization line (Cisco 10-Ks)

capex.source: FY2025: 905 from Cisco FY2025 filing 'Capital Expenditures' (acquisition of property and equipment) in sec.gov FY2025 results doc. FY2024 and FY2026: not found (search limit reached)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 grew 11.8% (63,325 vs 56,654) on AI infrastructure/networking orders strength; fade toward ~4% as the comparison base grows and AI demand normalizes.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 GAAP EBIT margin 25.4% (16,086/63,325); FY2024-25 were 24.3%/22.1%; hold near FY2026 level, slightly conservative given hardware mix/memory cost risk.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate Cisco GAAP effective tax rate, mid-to-high teens/low 20s; not verified in a filing in this session.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 4.05% (2,563/63,325), FY2025 5.1%; amortization of acquired intangibles (Splunk) declining so ~4.2%.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 905/56,654 = 1.6%; slightly higher for AI-driven investment. FY2026 capex not found.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM approx. rf ~4.3%, beta ~0.9-1.0, ERP ~5% gives cost of equity ~9-9.5%; modest debt weight at lower cost gives ~9%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP-like growth, below WACC; mature networking franchise.

net_debt.source: stockanalysis.com balance sheet: Net Cash (Debt) -15,267 = total debt 31,185 less cash 7,218 and short-term investments 8,700. CAVEAT: total debt may include lease liabilities (not separable; search limit reached), so net debt may be overstated by ~1-2bn. Long-term debt 19,372 + current portion 3,500 shown separately.

diluted_shares.source: Derived: FY2026 net income 13,267 / diluted EPS 3.33 = ~3,984m; consistent with H1 FY2026 diluted 3,987m in Q2 FY26 10-Q. Exact weighted-average diluted figure from 10-K not retrieved.
